blocks.text: The Zscaler and CoreWeave Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) features with the CoreWeave Cloud platform.

Users leveraging the CoreWeave Cloud platform must securely access their hosted infrastructure. ZPA is the solution to this requirement. Deploying ZPA App Connectors in your CoreWeave Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) environment enables secure Least Privileged Policy based access to your workloads.

ZPA App Connectors enhance CoreWeave’s existing defense-in-depth security architecture by reducing the attack surface of your workload environments, keeping them isolated and not exposed to the broader network.
